opportunities.title: [AI-BIO-04] Subtractive Spatial Multi-Omics: Steroid-Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis as 'Nature's Positive Control' for Fibrosis Reversal
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: Academic pathology biobank FFPE core collaboration (10x Visium HD / Xenium spatial transcriptomics on paired pre/post-rituximab or steroid AIMF biopsies vs non-reversing JAK2+ PMF) + in-silico perturbation target ranking.
opportunities.problem_wedge: Clinical dogma treats established human bone marrow fibrosis as an irreversible scar because all 4 approved JAK inhibitors fail to clear Grade 2/3 fibrosis in JAK2+ PMF. Yet in Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF—JAK2/CALR/MPL-negative, lupus/autoantibody-driven), reticulin fibrosis completely resolves in 74-80% of patients within 3-12 months of immunosuppression (Gangat et al., Mayo Clinic, Br J Haematol 2024).
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Contrast spatial and single-cell stromal states of resolving human AIMF marrow against persistent JAK2+ PMF (GSE156644, GSE144568) to isolate the exact myofibroblast de-differentiation and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP-1/8/13 vs TIMP-1 / GLI1 / S100A8/A9) switches—unlocking orthogonal stromal antifibrotics applicable across PMF, IPF, and systemic sclerosis.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $90,000 - $220,000 (archived FFPE core spatial profiling of 15-20 AIMF vs PMF pairs via academic hematopathology DUA + computational target discovery)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Direct stromal fibrosis-reversing therapy addresses 100% of Myelofibrosis genotypes ($2B+ market) with platform expansion into Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis ($4B+).
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: High-value biopharma target-discovery & 505(b)(2)/NCE option deals ($50M-$250M+ upfront/milestones for validated human-in-vivo fibrosis reversal targets).

opportunities.regulatory_pathway: FDA Orphan Drug Designation as an antifibrotic combination backbone in Myelofibrosis + FDA RDEA quantitative pathomics endpoint.
first_90_days_milestones: Execute IRB-exempt archival FFPE tissue collaboration with 1-2 academic hematopathology & rheumatology centers (Mayo / French AIMF consensus criteria).
Generate spatial transcriptomic maps around resolving polyclonal T/B lymphoid aggregates in AIMF vs neoplastic megakaryocyte clusters in JAK2+ PMF.
Rank druggable extracellular/stromal switches separating reversible reticulin remodeling from cross-linked collagen persistence.
File target/repurposing IP and submit MPN Research Foundation Challenge + NIH SBIR Phase I applications.

opportunities.title: [PUBLIC-HEALTH-03] Multi-Modal Biopsy, Iron-Hepcidin & Autoimmune Triage Engine Preventing Catastrophic AIMF vs. Triple-Negative PMF Misdiagnosis
opportunities.wet_lab_execution_model: 100% software / EHR + digital pathology clinical decision support bridging rheumatology (SLE/UCTD) and community hematology.
opportunities.problem_wedge: Patients presenting with 'dry tap' marrow fibrosis, severe cytopenias, and massive iron buildup (from RBC transfusions + IL-6/hepcidin macrophage iron trapping) who test negative for JAK2/CALR/MPL face 30-40% diagnostic discordance. Misdiagnosing curable Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) as Triple-Negative PMF subjects patients to ineffective $20K/mo cytopenic JAK inhibitors or 20-35% mortality stem cell transplants instead of curative steroids/rituximab.
opportunities.solution_blueprint: Build a 21st Century Cures CDS & WSI morphometry triage engine integrating megakaryocyte clustering/atypia vs polyclonal CD3/CD20 lymphoid aggregates, extended myeloid NGS clonality (ASXL1/SRSF2 absence), lupus/ANA/Coombs serology, and ferritin/TSAT/hepcidin kinetics to flag AIMF and transfusional/inflammatory iron overload early.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $45,000 - $130,000 (retrospective WSI + EHR lab validation across 150 triple-negative vs autoimmune fibrotic marrows)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Saves payors $200K-$600K per prevented futile JAKi regimen or inappropriate allo-HSCT; simultaneously enriches true clonal Triple-Negative PMF & ACVR1/hepcidin anemia trials for biopharma sponsors.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Dual revenue from value-based payor/reference-lab hematopathology licensing (Labcorp / Quest / NeoGenomics channel) + biopharma trial-screening contracts.

opportunities.regulatory_pathway: Transparent clinician-facing CDS under 21st Century Cures Act -> CLIA reference-lab algorithm -> FDA 510(k)/De Novo SaMD.
first_90_days_milestones: Encode Pullarkat / Vergara-Lluri / Mayo 2024 AIMF consensus criteria alongside MIPSS70+ v2.0 and dual iron-overload (TSAT vs ferritin/hepcidin) rules into an open FHIR calculator.
Fine-tune WSI pathology classifier distinguishing scattered normoblastic megakaryocytes + lymphoid islands (AIMF) from cloud-like clustered megakaryocytes (TN-PMF).
Partner with Lupus & MPN advocacy groups to map diagnostic delay between rheumatology and hematology clinics.
